info.description: Unblocking and web data API for AI agents: any URL as clean Markdown, HTML or text, screenshots and PDFs of pages, YouTube transcripts, Google Maps reviews, job listings, Google News, Amazon reviews, web search with page content and fast search with excerpts, plus social, maps and search data as JSON. Endpoints: unblock, instagram, google-maps, tiktok, linkedin, youtube, twitter, reddit, amazon, google-search, google-maps-reviews, youtube-transcript, screenshot, linkedin-jobs, indeed-jobs, shopify-products, google-news, amazon-reviews, google-play-reviews, linkedin-company, web-search, x-replies, youtube-comments, tiktok-comments, instagram-comments, ebay-sold, meta-ads, search-plus. Returns structured JSON. Payment is in stablecoins: x402 on Base and Polygon (plus Solana on some routes) or MPP on Base. x402 uses the exact scheme; no API keys, accounts or subscriptions. A failed scrape is never charged; otherwise a call pays a small fixed fee plus the results it returns, and results paid for but not delivered are refunded. Feedback is free: POST /feedback (or the MCP tool feedback) sends a note to the people who run the service. Every response carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset and RateLimit-Policy headers: they show the per-IP budget of the request class (free documents 120 per minute, unpaid quote requests 300 per minute; a request that carries a payment is never limited). Free GET documents (/openapi.json, /llms.txt, /agents.md, /pricing.md, /docs, /ask and /health) are limited to 120 requests per minute per client IP and return RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset and RateLimit-Policy; a 429 also includes Retry-After. API deprecation policy: https://agdata.shveik.dev/deprecation-policy.

info.x-guidance: POST a small JSON body (see each operation's requestBody) with no payment to get a 402 carrying a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402) and a WWW-Authenticate: Payment challenge (MPP). Sign either and retry the same request with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (x402) or Authorization: Payment (MPP) to receive the JSON dataset. The 402 quotes the price for your requested limit: a fixed per-call fee plus a per-result price for each result; endpoints without a limit field return one result. If fewer results come back than you asked for, the per-result price of the missing ones is refunded on-chain to the paying address (refunds too small to be worth a transfer are not sent); a scrape with no results keeps only the fixed fee and refunds every result; a failed scrape is not settled. post.description: Keyword search on Amazon.com (US store): up to 20 products per call, each filled in from its product page. Body: {query, limit}. 400.description: Invalid request: a request body that is invalid (a payment was attached; without a payment an invalid body gets the 402 below), or a payment header that cannot be read (error invalid_payment). Nothing is charged.

schema.description: The x402 PaymentRequired object (the same as the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header).

402.description: Payment required: the quote, with both challenges (also the answer when a payment was not accepted: read error). An unpaid request with an invalid body also gets this 402, quoted for 1 result, with X-Agdata-Invalid-Request: 1 and the reason in error; do not sign that one.

WWW-Authenticate.description: MPP Payment challenge (RFC 9110 auth-params): id, realm, method=evm, intent=charge, request.

X-Agdata-Invalid-Request.description: 1 when the request body is invalid and the quote is for 1 result only.

409.description: The same payment is already being worked on: wait and retry with the same payment.

413.description: The request body is over 65536 bytes.

422.description: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.

500.description: Internal error: no payment was settled for it.

502.description: Nothing was delivered: a video without subtitles in the requested language. Error not_fetched; the payment is not settled and nothing is charged. Also the answer when the upstream failed (upstream_failed) or the payment could not be settled (settlement_failed).

503.description: Temporarily unavailable (the endpoint, a payment network or the upstream is switched off or over its failure budget): no payment was taken. Try again later.

post.summary: YouTube transcript of a video

x-quote-probe.description: GET /x402/youtube-transcript with no body answers the 402 quote for one result without starting a scrape. A quote for a request-specific limit needs this POST body.

servers.description: Current stable API routes; legacy unversioned routes remain available.

tags.description: Synchronous data retrieval; each request completes in the HTTP response.
tags.name: Scraping

x-api-versioning.policy: The /v1 prefix identifies the current stable API. Unversioned paths remain compatibility aliases. Breaking changes will use a new major path and be announced with a deprecation period; no fixed sunset date is promised.
